title: Your words stay where you started
summary: Start dictating in one app, glance at another, and your words still land where your cursor was.

highlights.title: Switch apps while you talk
body: Sayrite now remembers the text box you started in. If you move to another app before you finish, your words still go into that box, usually without pulling you back. When a message needs sending, Sayrite returns to it for a moment, sends, and brings you right back.

changes.text: Dictation no longer disappears when you switch to another app before it's typed.

title: Updates arrive on their own
summary: Sayrite now keeps itself up to date, so you always have the newest features and fixes without downloading anything again.

highlights.title: Sayrite updates itself
body: Every few hours Sayrite checks for a new version. When there is one, it downloads quietly in the background and checks it really comes from us before installing anything.
To finish, choose **Restart to Update** in the menu bar or in Settings. Busy? Sayrite restarts on its own once you've stepped away for a while, never in the middle of a dictation.

media.alt: Settings showing Restart to Update to 0.2.1

highlights.title: See what's new
body: This page is new too. Each update lists what changed, with screenshots, and you can follow along with the RSS feed.

changes.text: **Check for Updates…** in the menu bar, to look for a new version right away.
Settings no longer says your recordings are sent away when you use Apple's built-in speech recognition. It runs on your Mac, and your audio stays there.

title: Sayrite is here
summary: The first download of Sayrite for Mac. Click the mic or hold a key, say what you mean, and polished text appears in any app.

highlights.title: Speak anywhere you type
body: Click the mic that appears in any text box, or hold [[Right Option]], and talk. Sayrite types clean, punctuated text straight into the app you're in: Mail, Slack, Notes, your browser, anything.
Words show up as you speak, so you can see it's listening. Say **"send now"** when you're done, and the message sends itself.

media.alt: Words appearing in a note while Sayrite listens

highlights.title: Your voice can stay on your Mac
body: Pick how Sayrite hears you. Apple's built-in recognition (macOS 26) and Whisper both run entirely on your Mac, even offline. Prefer the cloud? Connect Groq or OpenAI and your recordings go straight to them, never to us.

media.alt: Speech settings with on-device and cloud options

highlights.title: Writes like you, minus the ums
body: Sayrite drops filler words, applies spoken corrections ("Tuesday, no wait, Wednesday" becomes "Wednesday") and, if you connect Claude, OpenAI or Groq, fixes grammar in your own style.

media.alt: Writing settings with Claude chosen for grammar correction

changes.text: **Your Words**: teach Sayrite names and terms, and it learns from the fixes you make.
**Hands-free mode**: keep talking as long as you like, and Sayrite types it all at the end.
**iCloud sync**: your words, style and preferences follow you to every Mac.
Signed with our Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens with a normal double-click.
